permanent scrollback. Both changes are unconditional. The gate vocabulary is a closed list and is not
touched here.

tasks.title: the context watcher gates its destructive act on a trustworthy reading
tasks.goal:
The watcher beats its tier on any successful read. It authorises a clear only on a marked reading
and wakes a supervisor when the reading is unmarked. An unmarked percentage proves liveness; it does
not authorise destroying a seat's context. A wait ending without its watched condition is reported as a
negative result. Outcomes are a closed enumerated list of three: condition met; timed out; unreadable.

acceptance.test: an unmarked reading above the threshold beats the tier yet sends no clear; a marked reading above the threshold sends one so liveness and authority stop sharing an evidence bar
a statusline whose only percentage belongs to another field authorises no clear so a stray figure cannot destroy a healthy seat's context
a wait ending without its watched condition reports the timeout outcome rather than the condition outcome so an instrument cannot report success as failure

acceptance.text: the diff gates only the destructive branch on the marked reading so the beat still fires on any successful read
